steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Responses screen containing Vendor A's normal bid.
Enable the RFQ counter-offer UI required by the case.
Enable eRFX projects required by the case.
Send Vendor A a counter offer at 90 for the bid line.
Verify that the buyer's grid marks the counter offer as initiated.
Have Vendor A accept the pending counter offer in the supplier portal.
Verify that Vendor A's bid is marked as having an accepted counter offer.
Open the comparison grid to inspect the accepted bid's updated commercial value, although this does not prove the final award.
Verify that the accepted counter-offer rate is shown as 90 per unit in Master QCS.
Verify that the updated bid total is 900 for the 10 requested units.
